Name: Single Pour Drip Bags
Tasting_Notes: We can’t tell you what you’ll taste because every palate is different. Brew it, sip it, and tell us what you taste
Desc: For us, it’s all about sharing our roasts with you without the need for any equipments or fuss. Drip bags make it easier than ever-perfect for anyone craving pure flavour and convenience, or for those who need their coffee on-the-go. Just follow the below steps to brew one satisfying cup at a time: Step 1: Tear along the perforation. Step 2: Pull the flaps out and hang onto the cup. Step 3: Boil 180ml of water. Rest boiling water for about 1 min before pouring. Pour 30ml of hot water to soak the coffee and let it bloom for 30s. Slowly pour another 150ml. Step 4: Let it rest until 2 mins before removing the bag. Qty: 11g per bag / 6 drip bags in a pack Indicative flavour notes: We can’t tell you what you’ll taste because every palate is different. Brew it, sip it, and tell us what you taste.
